description: Implementation of the IpcModuleBase class providing mock expectations for IPC communication in tests, including channel attachment, API call success/failure, disconnection, and reconnection scenarios.

classes.name: IpcModuleBase
classes.description: Base class providing mock expectation methods for IPC communication scenarios in tests.

methods.name: expectInitIpc
methods.description: Sets expectation for initializing IPC by attaching a channel.

methods.name: expectInitIpcButAttachChannelFailure
methods.description: Sets expectation for failure during channel attachment.

methods.name: expectAttachChannel
methods.description: Sets expectations for successfully attaching a channel and verifying connection.

methods.name: expectIpcApiCallSuccess
methods.description: Sets expectations for a successful IPC API call sequence.

methods.name: expectIpcApiCallFailure
methods.description: Sets expectations for a failed IPC API call sequence.

methods.name: expectIpcApiCallDisconnected
methods.description: Sets expectations for handling a disconnected IPC channel.

methods.name: expectIpcApiCallReconnected
methods.description: Sets expectations for re-establishing IPC connection after disconnection.
